programs.description: The filmmaker travels across the globe to document some of the strongest animals living on vast landscapes who have endured the rigors of nature.
The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild.
The filmmaker captures the dramatic seasonal changes of the Luangwa Valley, where rains transform the landscape into a thriving ecosystem teeming with wildlife and lush vegetation.
Canids and felines compete globally as apex hunters. A comparison of their force and cleverness shows which family rules a terrain.
The filmmaker chronicles the journey of four cubs in Zimbabwe, home to Africa's top predators, as they grow from two weeks to three-year-old hunters, evolving from 'cute to killer'.
The filmmaker sheds light on the not so well known story, the true nature and life of a seriously misunderstood and neglected mammal on earth, a giant hippo bull.
The team documents the daily life and struggle of families of different species of big cats as they strive to hunt, mate, defend territories and bring up their young in the wild.
The filmmaker explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species.
The filmmaker explores the lives of animals at the Bronx Zoo, showcasing the dedication of staff as they care for the creatures, protect endangered species and champion global wildlife conservation.
The Irwin family showcases their daily challenges and triumphs in caring for an array of exotic creatures at the Australia Zoo.
The host sheds light on the wildlife from different parts of the world while explaining the protective and fierce nature of animals.
